name: Tokn
tagline: A tiny, no-fuss 2FA app for your accounts
description:
Tokn is a small, focused two-factor authentication app that does one thing well: generate the 6-digit codes that keep your accounts safe. No extra features, no clutter, just a clean and reliable authenticator.

It works fully offline and keeps your 2FA secrets on your device, giving you a simple, open-source alternative to bulkier authenticator apps.
